items.title: Operator-norm biorthogonal expansion, immediate compactness and simple spectral mapping for nonlocal Jacobi semigroups
items.difficulty_reason: H3: existence of the nonlocal Markov semigroup and the classical Jacobi orthogonal expansion do not transfer a spectral theorem through a merely bounded intertwining. The author constructs co-eigenfunctions by a uniquely solved distributional Mellin convolution, obtains weighted-Hilbert representations and complete biorthogonal Bessel systems in both root regimes, lifts polynomial intertwinings through resolvents, and controls polynomial norm growth by quadratic spectral damping to prove operator-norm convergence for every positive time. Immediate compactness, algebraic/geometric simplicity and semigroup-generator spectral mapping then follow with the exact external inputs; a separate polynomial-moment argument characterizes self-adjointness. These are the theorem-specific new constructions and estimates; the old generator/invariant-law proof remains supplied input, not a second counted claim.

dedup.scope: Current master same-source2045 and bounded Jacobi/semigroup/non-self-adjoint/biorthogonal spectral neighborhood; actual nearest primary statements inspected; no queued new batch

compared.relation: Same work exact Theorem2.1 nonzero-kernel generation/invariant density/polycore only. Spectral expansion and entropy were explicitly excluded from its selected primary; complete old core reused.

Actual Proposition pro3 concerns the Jacobi-Cherednik heat kernel on R via a continuous transform integral and heat equation, not a compact [0,1] downward-jump Jacobi semigroup with discrete biorthogonal operator-norm expansion.

Actual Theorem3.1 tt2_1 characterizes the spectral functional of a real five-diagonal Jacobi-type pencil by an integral representation and polynomial operator constraints, not a Markov semigroup spectral theorem.
Actual thm:stability is a BDF2 discretization energy/stability estimate for the FENE model with a time-step condition, not continuous nonlocal semigroup spectral mapping.

Actual lem:highest_order_generated expresses the highest-order part of a triangle Jacobi spectral-algebra differential operator in two generators, not a one-dimensional nonlocal Markov operator or biorthogonal series.
